notes.title: Post Dreamhack Update!!! (NEW MAP)
notes.content:
Hello!

Now that easter is over there have been some changes to the game

-- Pausing no longer stops your timer. There were ways to take advantage of that and spoof the scores

--The level select screen has been spruced up a bit with some of my opinions on each levels difficulty

--The Dreamhack level has been moved to the normal level select screen

-- NEW MAP : 100 Pins has been added to the game. Its exactly what it sounds like. A lane with 100 pins

--Various other changes that maybe I dont remember including times are now truncated to seconds in the leaderboards
 If we come to a time with scores are tied way too often, we can add another decimal point

Other than that , Have Fun!

notes.title: Super Duper Minor Fix
notes.content:
Fixed the leaderboards time scale

Used to say xxxxms as in 2700ms but as I've recently come to realize (Thanks Jo) thats 2.7 seconds lol

Fixed the output to be in seconds rather than ms on the leaderboards

notes.title: DreamHack Update!!!!
notes.content:
So theres actually quite a bit packed into this update

1. There are now pause menus instead of Esc/Select just returning you to the main menu. The Pausemenus will have some quick settings for you to adjust as well

2.Hedgemaze has been rebuilt and as a result, all highscores have been reset. (If this doesnt fix that leaderboard issue then Im considering that rabbit hole cursed)

3.Multiplayer has received a bit more love in the form of a quick menu you can open with TAB. This menu gives you the ability to change the graphics settings as well as skins in the multiplayer game

4. THE DREAMHACK DALLAS MAP IS NOW AVAILABLE FROM THE MAIN MENU!!!! More info to come on what exactly that means ;) Dont get too Excited, ALL HISCORES WILL BE RESET ON THE 17th

5. There is a ticker that runs along the bottom of the Main Menu now that showcases the top 30 players to complete the DH Dallas Map

6. I think that is all

7. I may have forgotten a few things but if you run into any issues just HMU on Bluesky or on discord @Hashtagshrekt
